not_enabled: Suggestions are not enabled on this server.
no_channel: No suggestions channel is configured. An admin needs to run `/suggest config`.
channel_gone: The configured suggestions channel no longer exists. An admin needs to run `/suggest config` again.
post_failed: The suggestion was saved but could not be posted to the channel (missing bot permissions?). Please notify an admin.
vote_no_perm_desc: Only members with the <@&{role}> role may vote on suggestions.
vote_closed_decided: This suggestion has already been decided — voting is closed.
decide_not_configured_desc: No decision role is configured for this server.
decide_no_perm_desc: Only the configured role may decide on suggestions.
decide_already_desc: This suggestion has already been decided.
submit_ok_desc: Your suggestion has been posted — thanks for the input!
